verdict.rationale: Maritime documents broad programmatic coverage: a RESTful API for managing agents, a CLI built for AI agents that uses the same Bearer token as the API, TypeScript/Python SDKs with idempotent provisioning, a Files API, and webhooks. However, several workflows are described only in the UI. These include creating a Computers-scoped key in Settings, installing the GitHub App via Settings, viewing live build logs on the agent page, and customizing templates from the agent page. No OpenAPI spec could be found to verify coverage. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, API equivalents for Settings-only actions (scoped Computers keys, GitHub App connection), API access to build-log streaming and template customization, a published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.
